about_the_game:
Victory Acres is a strategic farming life-sim set set in the 1940s. Plow, seed, irrigate, and harvest with period farming equipment. Grow, ship, and strategize while community morale shifts with your decisions and the island's anthropomorphic townsfolk react to your choices. Your crops feed more than your wallet—shipments, shortages, and community projects nudge island morale, changing prices and events.

Start small and practical: patchwork fields, a temperamental tractor, a couple of paying contracts. Grow into tidy rows, sprinklers, proper storage, and a reliable shipping route. Visit the bank for loans (or war bonds), resupply at Union Farm Co., grab a coffee at The Signal Café, and toast to a good haul at Clara’s Pub.

Key Features

  • Hands-on Farming, 1940s Style – Plow, seed, irrigate, and harvest with period machinery that feels weighty and satisfying.

  • Shipping & Logistics – Dispatch orders to customers to ring in your profits and supply the island

  • Economy With Stakes – Prices, demand, and island morale shift based on contracts filled, shortages, and community goals.

  • Town Life – A living town with shops, a bank, a café, a pub, and a townsfolk with satisfyingly deep connections and daily routines that react to you!

  • Progression That Pops – Upgrade tools, vehicles, irrigation, storage, and routes; unlock new crops and efficiency perks.

  • Stylized 40s Aesthetic – Detailed retro environments that feel lived-in: Vintage buildings, period technology, and cozy interiors that make the era feel authentic.

The Road to Victory

From furrow to freight, every choice you make travels farther than the farm. Supply the island, lift its morale, and turn hard work into hope. Will you deliver victory when it counts?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Catalina (10.15) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or newer) OR Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 555X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Monterey 12+
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 chip or Intel Core i7 (8th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2/M3 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
